samples.xml_description:
Implement a 64-bit ripple carry adder with 16-bit registers to enable 4 pipeline stages. Clock input. Active low reset signal. Enable signal for addition operation. 64-bit input operand A. 64-bit input operand B. 65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb. Output enable signal. 4 1-bit input enable signal register. 1-bit carry-in signal register. 64-bit sum register.

Reset the input enable signal register to 0.

On each clock cycle, if the reset signal is not asserted, update the input enable signal register with the input enable signal.

Reset the carry-in signal register to 0.

On each clock cycle, if the reset signal is not asserted, update the carry-in signal register with the carry-in signal.

Reset the sum register to 0.

On each clock cycle, if the reset signal is not asserted, update the sum register with the sum of the corresponding input operands and carry signals.

Assign the result output to the sum register.

Assign the output enable signal to the input enable signal register.
